en: A sepia-toned image showing several people lying in beds on the covered porch of a wooden building. The porch is open to a garden with small trees and bushes in the foreground. The people, possibly patients, are covered with blankets and attended by a person who appears to be a nurse or nun. The architecture and clothing suggest an early 20th-century setting, possibly related to a sanatorium or hospital.
